Filter('CH-Tbl-ClientTableLogicalFieldNames', Table = gvarSolicitudSel.TargetTable && IsAllowed && !(LogicalName in colLineasDet.'Field Definition'.LogicalName))

If(
    IsBlank(drpCampoDet.Selected),
    "—",
    If(
        IsBlank(colTargetRecordDet) || CountRows(colTargetRecordDet) = 0,
        "(sin registro objetivo)",
        If(
            // Misma excepcion de ClientAccount que en (j) de §6.2 — ver comentario ahi (gotcha 8.16).
            // Literal = LOGICAL NAME (D6 de 01 RESUELTA — ver 02 DC3 / 03 hallazgo crítico #3).
            gvarSolicitudSel.TargetTable = "sanic_chtblclientaccount" && drpCampoDet.Selected.LogicalName = "sanic_name",
            Text(First(colTargetRecordDet).'Numero de cuenta'),
            Switch(
                drpCampoDet.Selected.LogicalName,
                "sanic_cifbco", Text(First(colTargetRecordDet).CIFBCO),
                "sanic_cifcom", Text(First(colTargetRecordDet).CIFCOM),
                "sanic_name", Text(First(colTargetRecordDet).Name),
                "emailaddress", Text(First(colTargetRecordDet).'Email Address'),
                "sanic_alwaysnotify", If(First(colTargetRecordDet).AlwaysNotify, "Sí", "No"),
                "sanic_currency", Text(First(colTargetRecordDet).Moneda),
                "—" // LogicalName sin mapear todavia — completar contra el catalogo real (Notas)
            )
        )
    )
)

If(
    gvarSolicitudSel.Type = 'Type (CH-Tbl-ClientDataChangeRequests)'.Create,
    "(registro nuevo — se crea al aprobar)",
    If(
        gvarSolicitudSel.TargetTable = "sanic_chtblclient",
        Coalesce(gvarSolicitudSel.TargetTableDisplayName, gvarSolicitudSel.TargetTable),
        Switch(
            gvarSolicitudSel.TargetTable,
            "sanic_chtblclientbranch", First(colTargetRecordDet).Name,
            "sanic_chtblclientemail", First(colTargetRecordDet).Name,
            "sanic_chtblclientaccount", First(colTargetRecordDet).'Numero de cuenta',
            "—"
        )
    )
)
